parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description:
The cluster ID.

For more information, see [ListClusters](~~87116~~).

parameters.name: Instance
parameters.description: The information about the nodes to stop.

sub_parameters.name: Id
sub_parameters.description:
The ID of the Nth node to stop. N is an integer from 1 to 100.

For more information, see [ListNodes](~~87161~~).

parameters.name: Role
parameters.description:
The role of the nodes. Valid values:

- Manager: management node
- Login: logon node
- Compute: compute node

Default value: Compute
